title: A cue without a silhouette
hook: A hidden animal can produce more than visual cues.

knows: Animals can respond to cues and conditions.
doesNotKnow: A toy scene has concealed prey that produces a weak electric field. Which cue is available to an electroreceptive predator in this model?

misconception: The stated evidence implies a different interpretation or a universal conclusion.
objective: A toy scene has concealed prey that produces a weak electric field. Which cue is available to an electroreceptive predator in this model?

claims.text: A toy scene has concealed prey that produces a weak electric field. Which cue is available to an electroreceptive predator in this model? The prey outline is hidden below the sediment, while curves indicate a stipulated electric field. Some fishes can detect weak electric fields with specialized receptors; the drawing is a schematic, not a measurement of detection range.
